overview_description.description:
Volts UAE Limited - developers and producers of smart energy storage systems for residential houses and villas energy control and management. VOLTS systems guarantee efficient and reliable power supply to provide our clients with maximum level of comfort.
VOLTS Hardware - patented storage system which ensure households owners that they will have independent and reliable energy source, can use solar energy in the most effective way even to make an absolute independent PV station, can add extra power to his house (for example, for EV charger).
VOLTS software makes it possible to control energy consumption/generation of an object, to switch between loads and electricity sources. Software creates unique consumprion scenarios basing on weather forecast and typical house consumption, gather detailed information about electricity in the grid and protects house from the possible blackouts.
